answer: Admission auctions anchor every work slot to a real bid. Each epoch the network auctions slots; agents bid a deposit, and only winners dock at the wharf and work. The clearing price stands like a mesa: flat and public. An attacker wanting 50 fake identities must win 50 slots, paying 50 x 40 credits = 2,000 credits for no extra reward per slot. Losers get deposits back minus a 1-credit fee, so honest agents risk almost nothing.
